# Bhanu Kowshik

> Design engineer in San Francisco who designs and builds AI products end to end: the product design, the interface and the code. Founder of Verified Call; sole product designer at EverTutor (2,000+ students a day).

Start with the brief: it summarises every project and labels how each claim was measured (published method, customer pilot, production data, or self-reported).

## Brief
- [AI brief](https://bhanu.build/ai.md): who he is, each project's role and results, and the evidence behind every number.

## Case studies
- [Verified Call](https://bhanu.build/verified-call.html): founder, solo design and engineering. Stops cheating in video interviews: a Mac and Windows app that checks the candidate and a panel inside Google Meet for the interviewer. Built in 3 weeks; 20 companies in the closed beta.
- [Stressie](https://bhanu.build/stressie-v4.html): founding product designer; designed in Figma and built the iOS app in SwiftUI. A stress check-in that pays for your evening; daily engagement 12% to 56%.
- [EverTutor Live](https://bhanu.build/evertutor-live.html): sole product designer. A real-time voice AI tutor; 1:1 tutoring from $250 to $5 an hour.
- [EverTutor Studio](https://bhanu.build/evertutor-studio.html): lead product and curriculum designer. The authoring tool that cut lesson creation from 104 hours to 4.

## Visuals
- [Visual review pack](https://bhanu.build/review/): rendered screenshots and short clips of every page at desktop and phone sizes, for reviewers who cannot render the site's WebGL, video and motion. Markdown version: https://bhanu.build/review/README.md
